products.name: Devin (Cognition)
products.note: Autonomous software engineer; full codebase access; high decision-influence; security critical

profile_text.body:
Cognition is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a team of interdisciplinary makers focused on what it calls the biggest shift in computing since the invention of software, and it works with enterprises and technology companies.

Cognition's primary product is Devin, which the company describes as the first autonomous software engineer. According to the site, Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code within existing workflows. The company also tracks Windsurf, an AI-integrated development environment. Both products involve substantial access to code and systems, with Devin in particular noted for full codebase access and high decision influence, making it security critical.

The site's held facts associate Cognition with 161 legal cases in California, though no specific lawsuits or named parties are detailed in the available data. The company has a profile page on theworldofai.org and no MCP server presence on record.
